title: QA↔BIZ-001: Quality Metrics for Business Cases + Market Quality Requirements (DERIVED — provisional)
description: QA supplies quality and reliability metrics (coverage, defect-escape, field-quality, RPN burn-down) as objective evidence for business cases, SLA commitments, and GTM readiness; Business Consultant supplies market-driven quality requirements (customer SLA expectations, warranty/return tolerances, competitive quality bars). SOURCE GAP: there is NO direct §6 contract on either the QA or Business Consultant side (QA §6 lists no BIZ; BIZ §6 lists no QA). This schema is DERIVED from QA_TEST_AUTOMATION_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.8 (quality/release-readiness reporting) and the analogous DEVOPS_PLATFORM_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.10 BIZ pattern (reliability/uptime metrics feeding customer SLA commitments) + BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6.1 (GTM readiness / business-value inputs). It is PROVISIONAL pending ratification of a formal §6 QA↔BIZ contract (recommend a CCR). No quality thresholds are invented here.

quality_metrics.description: QA→BIZ: objective quality evidence for business cases. Targets are optional strings — not invented.

metric_name.description: e.g., defect escape rate, field MTBF, OTA success rate, RPN burn-down.

evidence_basis.description: Whether figures are measured or projected (must be disclosed).

warranty_return_tolerance.description: Acceptable field-failure/return rate as stated by BIZ (not fabricated; null if unspecified).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine quality-evidence exchange for business cases is agent-autonomous. Elevated by the source gap: see source_status.
x-macp.source_status: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — no direct §6 contract exists on either side (QA §6 lists no BIZ; BIZ §6 lists no QA). Composed from QA §6.8 + DEVOPS §6.10-BIZ pattern + BIZ §6.1. RECOMMENDED ACTION: ratify a formal QA↔BIZ §6 interface contract via a CCR before this schema is treated as authoritative. Until then, agents must COUNTER (request §6 ratification) rather than CONFIRM a binding change.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (at GTM readiness review; quarterly quality review) — provisional pending a ratified QA↔BIZ cadence
confirm_conditions: every quality metric carries a value and an explicit unit
market quality requirements expressed as BIZ-supplied values (not QA-invented)
metrics reported honestly against the market bar
reject_conditions: a quality figure presented as MEASURED when it is PROJECTED (or vice versa) — misrepresentation
a quality metric emitted without a unit
a quality target asserted that BIZ did not supply (no invented metrics — measure-first)
this provisional schema cited as a ratified contract without the recommended CCR
counter_conditions: ALWAYS until ratified: request a formal §6 QA↔BIZ contract + CCR before treating CONFIRM as binding
market quality requirement not measurable by QA — request an evaluable acceptance definition
business case needs a metric QA does not yet capture — request instrumentation before committing the figure
